title: Introduce recency-weighted regression sentinel and CI snapshooter
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a recency-weighted regression sentinel and a CI 'snapshooter' hook that captures time-binned evaluation snapshots. Motivation: some regressions are transient or only visible when weighting newer traffic higher; existing gates treat samples uniformly which delays detection for emerging degradations. This PR implements a sample-weighted time-binned comparator that applies exponential recency weighting and a severity curve to surface degradations quickly while avoiding noisy alerts. The CI hook can snapshot a configured prompt cohort at test time, run a lightweight ensemble of metric scorers, and post a summarized verdict to PR checks. Key behaviors: 1) bucket prompt-set results into hourly/daily bins; 2) compute recency-weighted aggregate and per-prompt deltas against an adaptive baseline; 3) generate soft-fail CI results for single-bin spikes and hard-fail only when sustained over configurable windows; 4) attach explainable failure snippets (top-k prompts with highest weighted delta) and suggested mitigation hints (reduce context length, increase beams, fallback model). Included a small runtime-friendly C implementation of the scoring kernel to reduce CI latency on large prompt cohorts, plus Python bindings. Backwards-compatible default config keeps existing gates unchanged unless teams opt-in. Checklist: - [x] core algorithm implemented - [x] unit tests for comparator and weighting - [x] integration test for CI snapshooter - [x] docs and migration guide - [x] perf microbenchmark added Links: Linear ENG-1429, related to ENG-880 (anchor replay work).

release_notes: Add recency-weighted regression sentinel for faster detection of emerging prompt-set degradations
Add CI snapshooter hook to capture time-binned evaluation snapshots and attach explainable deltas to PR checks
Performance: low-latency C scoring kernel to keep CI runs under acceptable thresholds
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is opt-in. Operators who enable the sentinel should tune 'recency_lambda' and 'sustain_window' in the operator config. The docs/operators/recency_sentinel.md contains migration steps and sample configs.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover comparator math, stability under outliers, and config parsing. Integration test runs on GitHub actions execute a 2k-prompt smoke cohort against a local scoring kernel; perf benchmark asserts CI run time < 6 minutes on standard runner. Recorded benchmark artifacts attached to PR.
motivation_context: Teams observed that small but consistent recent degradations took multiple releases to surface because uniform sample weighting smoothed signals with older baseline traffic. This approach prioritizes recent evidence while providing controlled attenuation to avoid noisy rollouts.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: overly aggressive recency weighting might cause false positives on short transient failures. Mitigation: snapshooter defaults to soft-fail on single-bin spikes and requires sustained deviation across multiple bins before escalations. Configurable thresholds and an emergency bypass flag added.
upgrade_instructions: 1) pip install -e . or build wheel including the scoring kernel. 2) add ['recency_sentinel'] to enabled_hooks in eval_harness config. 3) opt into CI workflow by enabling ci/github_checks/recency_snapshooter_workflow.yml in repo settings. See docs/operators/recency_sentinel.md for knobs.
automations: When sustained regression is detected the hook will: 1) mark the GitHub check as failed (hard-fail only after sustain window), 2) create a templated Linear card with top-5 failing prompts and metric deltas, 3) attach gzipped snapshot artifacts to the PR check.
backcompat_notes: No behavioral change until the hook is enabled. The scoring kernel exposes the same public scoring API as existing comparators; teams can drop-in replace evaluators by switching the comparator setting.
changelog_entry: 2026-02-20: Added recency-weighted sentinel and CI snapshooter (ENG-1429).
estimated_impact: Should reduce time-to-detect emerging degradations by ~3x for prompt cohorts where recent traffic diverges from historical baseline (internal benchmark).
related_work: Builds on anchor replay and ensemble comparators; complements ENG-880 anchor replay logic by adding a time-sensitive signal layer.
